purpose: A merge that reorganises the tree inside the merge commit.

windows.head: m_plain
windows.note: a clean merge of a content edit: nothing moved

windows.head: m_evil
windows.note: the destination exists only in the merge commit

notes: A conflict resolution that turns into a reorganisation is a move that exists in exactly one window, and the shipped default policy drops that window. This is the merge finding at its sharpest: the pairing is easy and the visibility is the problem.
